verses.pali: “Sattime, bhikkhave, bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these seven awakening factors don’t arise to be developed and cultivated apart from the Holy One’s training.
The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti.
verses.english: These seven awakening factors don’t arise to be developed and cultivated apart from the Holy One’s training.”
